svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: VM V on host 1 sends to an outside address. Its VM hook finds the longest matching gateway route, 2000::/3 via the gateway VM, and sends a tunnel with next header 254 and the gateway address to host 2.
